about: Voiceover of the Kompass demo video. `text` is what the line says (subtitles, SCRIPT.md); `say` is the same line spelled for the speech model where it would mispronounce it (Jan → Yan, AI → A.I., numbers as words). Change a line, then run `npm --prefix demo run vo`: only changed lines are generated again. `seed` picks the take; change it to re-roll one line.

lines.say: Five twenty-two p.m. Yan's car won't charge. Again.

lines.text: The next morning, his inbox lights up: “Switch your tariff and save!”
lines.say: The next morning, his inbox lights up: Switch your tariff, and save!

lines.text: MAINGAU knows a lot about its customers: contracts, charging, tickets, consents. 647 signals on a single day.
lines.say: Mine-gow knows a lot about its customers. Contracts. Charging. Tickets. Consents. Six hundred and forty-seven signals, on a single day.

lines.text: But the newsletter still goes to everyone, with the same text. 0.6 % convert, and nobody can say what worked.
lines.say: But the newsletter still goes to everyone, with the same text. Zero point six percent convert. And nobody can say what worked.

lines.text: What if every customer got the next right step? At the right moment, on a channel they said yes to.
Meet Kompass. It turns every customer signal into the next right step, and a human approves every message.
lines.say: Meet Kompass. It turns every customer signal into the next right step. And a human approves every message.

lines.text: Kompass reads every event from our insights service the moment it happens. Every event re-ranks that customer: churn risk, the best offer and what it's worth, and the best time to reach them.
Clara from CRM starts her day here. Every draft shows its channel, its offer, what it's worth, and why. Nothing goes out without her.
Remember Jan? In service mode, Mehmet sees the failed charge first. Kompass puts the fix on top, and holds back every offer while Jan is upset.
lines.say: Remember Yan? In service mode, Mehmet sees the failed charge first. Kompass puts the fix on top, and holds back every offer, while Yan is upset.

lines.text: And you can use AI to do everything.
lines.say: And you can use A.I. to do everything.

lines.text: Just ask. Kompass opens a campaign, picks the audience and the offer, finds each customer's best time, and writes every message, in Du and in Sie.
lines.say: Just ask. Kompass opens a campaign, picks the audience and the offer, finds each customer's best time, and writes every message. In doo, and in zee.

lines.text: Charts. Customer lists. Campaigns. It works right on screen, where you can watch it.
Consent, open complaints and contact limits are checked for every single customer. Clara approves, and only then does anything go out.
Every campaign keeps a control group, so you can prove what worked.
Kompass. Live data in. The next right step out. Humans in control.
